adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the event is built with `destinationCalendar: ... : null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` is present. Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. Because `destinationCalendar` can be `null`, this optional-chained push becomes a no-op and any teammate destination calendars accumulated in `teamDestinationCalendars` are silently dropped. The diff shows no error/warning in this path. The finding’s additional claim that this results in *no* calendar events being created at all is not fully provable from the shown diff (EventManager has a fallback path when destinationCalendar is empty), but the silent drop/no-op is a real defect in this change.
